littleEndian.Uint16.limits: 68,100 boundary cases, including every 16-bit prefix, and 60,000 seeded observations using 17, 2718 and 65537. Observes the panic class without depending on compiler-specific text.
littleEndian.Uint16.configurations: Pinned native encoding/binary.LittleEndian.Uint16 compared to model and an independent bit-position oracle.

sizeof.claim: Computes the encoded fixed size of supported Go types and sums structure field widths without native padding. Illegal types return minus one and a nil reflect.Type panics.
sizeof.limits: 1,814 fixed layouts and 60,000 seeded layouts (17, 2718, 65537). Covers nested arrays, structs, pointers and slices with size arithmetic fitting native int. Cache timing and concurrency are outside scope.
sizeof.configurations: Pinned private same-package input and public binary.Size, with cold and warm struct cache results and an independent reflect layout oracle.
